title: 13. Palantir: Business & Valuation w/ Arny Trezzi
summary:
Palantir is known today for its hot stock, but not many people understand what the company does
or why it's accelerating its growth as it scales. This podcast aims to touch both sides of the story, the business and the valuation. We discussed the concept of asymmetry, what the company does,
its competitive advantages and valuation, among other things.

thesis: This episode argues that Palantir is a unique business anomaly expanding margins while accelerating growth, but its current valuation is expensive and relies on highly optimistic assumptions of 30% growth persisting for a decade. The speaker maintains a mixed stance, noting that while the business is strong, the stock price implies high expectations that offer limited margin of safety for value investors and decrease asymmetry.
